data.narrative:
Kodiak AI is a public-stage defense and security company that has raised $250M+ to date. The comparable universe in Defense & Security comprises 26 same-sector peers, including 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms. Top private comparables include Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here. The Defense & Security sector lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers meeting minimum threshold criteria—only 1 same-stage comparable was identified, well below the 3-peer minimum required for reliable triangulation. Attempting to broaden the peer set across all 26 same-sector companies would risk introducing heterogeneous business models, stages, and risk profiles that would distort median estimates beyond meaningful use.

The narrow public comp set (2 tickers) and fragmented private landscape (8 peers spanning diverse sub-segments and maturity stages) prevent conventional multiples-based valuation synthesis. Without sufficient granular financial data across stage-appropriate peers or disclosed revenue and margin figures for Kodiak AI itself, quantitative triangulation cannot be responsibly performed. Further analysis would require either expanded operational metrics from existing comparables, disclosed financials for the target, or identification of additional same-stage Defense & Security public listings to support reliable valuation range estimation.
